examined_formations.title: SUBCONTRACTOR_COI_COLLECTION_AND_CONTINUOUS_TRACKING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 分包商保险凭证追收与持续合规跟踪
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Upwork buyer is offering $18–$22/hour for 6+ months to email roughly 50 subcontractors every two days until COIs arrive, maintain Excel expiry dates and keep certificates current year-round. Certificial already digitizes COI requests, validates coverage against requirements, continuously monitors renewals/changes and can trigger downstream access/payment/order actions. The recurring human spend is real, but the exact control surface is mature.

examined_formations.title: END_TO_END_RFP_RESPONSE_OWNERSHIP
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current ongoing Upwork role offers $10–$65/hour for ownership of formal RFPs from requirement review through compliance matrix, drafting, knowledge-base maintenance and final submission. Loopio and other purpose-built 2026 RFP platforms already automate shredding, first drafts, content governance and cross-functional workflow. The residual work is company-specific positioning, unsupported-claim avoidance, pricing/certification decisions and management input, which remains recurring judgment rather than founder-free machine delivery.

examined_formations.title: B2B_PRODUCT_CATALOG_WEB_ENRICHMENT
examined_formations.chinese_title: B2B 商品目录网页检索与属性补全
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current buyers still hire people to verify MPN/SKU/product variants and source authoritative images or specifications across thousands of catalog items, including $6–$12/hour and low fixed-price jobs. Akeneo's July 2026 Web-Based Attribute Enrichment now searches the live web for missing product facts, returns source citations and supports human review and bulk workflow automation. The remaining commodity review labor is low-priced and does not establish normalized orchestration margin.

examined_formations.title: RENT_MANAGER_AI_LEASE_ABSTRACTION_AND_WRITEBACK
examined_formations.chinese_title: Rent Manager AI 商业租约抽取与审核写回
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current $2,000 phased Upwork engagement asks for Rent Manager API integration, Claude-based lease abstraction, source-linked human review and conditional write-back in customer-owned infrastructure. Exact preflight finds Bryckel listed in Rent Manager's official integration directory specifically for AI-powered lease abstraction and document automation, with a direct Rent Manager integration already announced. The job therefore proves custom implementation demand, not an unowned product category.

examined_formations.title: EXPORT_DOCUMENTATION_AND_TRADE_COMPLIANCE_OPERATIONS
examined_formations.chinese_title: 出口单证与贸易合规运营
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current Upwork role offers $10–$40/hour for 6+ months of export documentation, records and U.S./UK/EU trade-compliance work. IncoDocs already generates complete export document sets, removes re-entry, integrates with ERP/TMS/accounting and supports commercial invoices, bills of lading and certificates of origin. The portion not absorbed by document automation is jurisdiction/corridor-specific compliance judgment, an expert tail that violates normalized founder-independent delivery.

examined_formations.title: SOC2_READINESS_EVIDENCE_AND_AUDIT_SUPPORT
examined_formations.chinese_title: SOC 2 准备、证据收集与审计支持
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current SOC 2 specialist work pays roughly $25–$75/hour and asks for gap assessment, control mapping, remediation planning, evidence guidance and audit readiness. Vanta already automates evidence collection, runs continuous tests and gives auditors a dedicated review portal; Drata likewise automates evidence and continuous monitoring. Residual scope includes architecture-specific control design, interpretation and independent attestation, which remains expert or licensed-auditor work.
